Backend Engineer - Fraud & Risk Platform
Stripe
Seattle, WA

Role Overview:
Stripe builds economic infrastructure for the internet. As a Backend Engineer on the Fraud & Risk team, you will design and maintain high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems that evaluate transactions in real time.

Responsibilities:
- Build resilient, real-time backend services in Java and Python.
- Design event-driven data streaming pipelines using Kafka and SQL databases.
- Deploy scalable microservices containerized with Docker.
- Collaborate with machine learning engineers to integrate Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and PyTorch scoring models into the live payment path.

Requirements:
- Minimum 3+ years of backend software engineering experience.
- Strong proficiency in Python, Java, and SQL.
- Hands-on experience building distributed systems with Kafka and Docker.
- Familiarity with real-time scoring systems and ML inference (Scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with high-availability financial transaction systems.
- Understanding of fraud detection, anomaly detection, and risk scoring platforms.
